transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this reinstatement review. As we begin, I want to make sure we're all on the same page: the student has applied for reinstatement after a medical leave, and the draft plan currently lists 12 credits for the fall term, places STAT-210 in a regular daytime section, and contains no disability-accommodation or financial-aid conditions. Before I sign off on any plan, I need us to go through the standard cross-office review so we can confirm the plan is complete and appropriate. I'd like to hear from each of you on whether you see any issues or missing conditions we should address. Please go ahead.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue with the credit load. In my advising meeting this week, I confirmed that the student's continuing employment schedule permits a maximum of exactly 9 credits in the fall term. I recorded this in my advising notes, but the reinstatement draft still shows 12 credits. This means the draft plan as written is not feasible for the student and needs to be revised down to 9 credits before it can be approved.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a scheduling issue with STAT-210. I confirmed in the registrar's course inventory that the student's required STAT-210 section is offered only online in the summer term, not as a regular daytime section in the fall. The plan currently places STAT-210 in a regular daytime fall section, which is not available. The plan must move STAT-210 out of the fall daytime schedule and identify the online summer section instead. I should note that the inventory update has not yet reached the reinstatement file, which is likely why this wasn't caught earlier.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a missing disability-accommodation condition. My completed disability-services review confirms that this student has an active accommodation requiring 1.5-times testing time and a reduced-distraction testing setting. This accommodation record has not yet been attached to the reinstatement draft, which is why the plan currently shows no disability-accommodation conditions. The final written plan must include this accommodation condition before it is approved, so the student receives a complete plan showing all conditions attached to reinstatement.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a missing financial-aid condition. I've confirmed that reinstated financial-aid eligibility requires the student to sign an academic-progress contract by exactly August 15. However, our financial-aid system has not yet added that condition to the draft plan, which is why it currently shows no financial-aid conditions. The final written plan must include this academic-progress contract requirement with the August 15 deadline before it is approved, so the student receives a complete plan showing all conditions attached to reinstatement.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.accommodations_required: 1.5-times testing time and reduced-distraction testing setting

commitments.detail: Reduce fall term credits from 12 to 9 to match the student's employment schedule constraint.
Move STAT-210 from a regular daytime fall section to the online summer section as confirmed in the registrar's course inventory.
Include the active disability accommodation requiring 1.5-times testing time and a reduced-distraction testing setting in the written plan.
Include the requirement that the student sign an academic-progress contract by August 15 in the written plan.

Provide the student with a complete written plan showing all academic requirements and conditions attached to reinstatement, including the revised credit load, corrected STAT-210 placement, disability accommodations, and financial-aid contract deadline.
